meta.source: Sheets 0-5b Ma refined, MaKit, MaScreen, 0-6b Logo refined, UzumeMark2

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Sumi 墨 / Kinari 生成. App background. Panels (sidebar, side panel) use the same colour and are separated by `rule`, never by a tint or a shadow.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Toasts, dialogs and menus only — the one place a plane sits on the ground. Always framed by a 1 px `rule`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Ground at 80 % behind a modal dialog. The dialog itself stays on `surface` with a 1 px `rule`; no blur, no shadow.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Behind running games, Multiview tiles and cover art: the space the game draws into.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, item titles, values, primary labels. On ground, surface, stage, hover, pressed and selected: ≥ 12:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Body copy, chat, dialog text, the ensō stroke. ≥ 9:1 on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, inactive nav items and tabs, helper lines; meta text on surface, hover, pressed and selected (where `dim` is too weak). ≥ 5.2:1 on every ground in both themes. Also the frame of an unchecked checkbox (≥ 5.2:1, meets 3:1 for controls).

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Mono labels, meta and helper lines. Raised in the readable revision so it passes 4.5:1 on ground, surface, pressed, selected and stage in both themes (lowest: 4.5 on Sumi selected). Still the quietest text: never for a primary label.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Structural hairlines that are not controls: table heads, column and panel edges, register marks, dialog and menu frames. Control borders moved to `rule-control`.

tokens.name: rule-control
tokens.usage: Border of everything you can operate: text fields, selects, secondary buttons, chips, segments, the toggle track and checkboxes. ≥ 3:1 on ground, surface and stage in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11; Sumi 3.13–4.0, Kinari 3.15–3.86). Hover and focus go stronger (`ink-2`, `ink`).

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: Fill of count badges (nav counts, the bell count, tab counts) with `ground` text: neutral, so a count never looks like a warning. Same value as `ink`.

tokens.name: rule-2
tokens.usage: Quiet hairlines: row separators, tab baselines, the line above a tile's name bar.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Row, nav item and secondary/ghost button hover.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed, and toggled-on secondary (e.g. the Panel button while the side panel is open).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Yamabuki 山吹 — the one yellow, now with fewer jobs. A plane with Sumi text (`on-accent`) for exactly: the primary button (one per view), the focus ring, the active nav and tab marker (`marker-nav`, `marker-under`; on Kinari these use `accent-text`), progress fills, the warning square, the AUDIO tag and the speaking mark. NOT for selection (chips, segments, rows use `ink` / `selected`), not for count badges, never for text on Kinari.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover. `on-accent` text 10.8:1.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed. `on-accent` text 7.4 / 7.8 : 1.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, inline actions (Undo, Open Storage →) and the selected row number. Yamabuki itself on Sumi (9.5:1); Uguisu-cha 鶯茶 on Kinari (6.2:1), because Yamabuki as text on paper is 1.7:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Sumi text and glyphs on an `accent` plane (9.5:1), in both themes. From MaKit `accInk`.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected row, chip-free list item and menu item: a neutral tint, always with the 2 px `marker-start` in `ink` and weight 500. No yellow: yellow is for acting, not for choosing.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Sango-shu 珊瑚朱 / Enji 臙脂. Outlined danger buttons, square error icons, error text and borders, and danger `Tag`s (plane with `ground` text, 6.6 / 5.2 : 1). 6.7 / 5.2 : 1 on ground. Never a filled button, never a disc. Kinari darkened in the readable revision (#b94047 → #ac3a41) so error text also passes on `pressed` (4.99:1).

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the outlined danger button. From MaKit `dangerH`.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Wakatake 若竹 / Tokiwa 常盤. A 6 px square next to a word (Online, Saved), and the frame or plane of an ok `Tag` (plane with `ground` text and a ✓, 7.6 / 5.1 : 1). Never a larger fill, never text on its own. Kinari darkened (#007b43 → #006b3a) so it passes on `pressed` (5.4:1).

tokens.name: disabled-ground
tokens.usage: Fill of disabled buttons and fields. From MaKit.

tokens.name: disabled-ink
tokens.usage: Text of disabled controls. Exempt from 4.5:1 (WCAG inactive); a disabled control carries a reason line in `muted` where space allows. From MaKit.

tokens.name: disabled-rule
tokens.usage: Border of disabled controls. From MaKit.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Fill of a cover or game screen before its image arrives. From MaScreen `gFill`.

tokens.name: placeholder-rule
tokens.usage: Frame of a game screen inside the stage. From MaScreen `gLine`.

tokens.name: person-wasurenagusa
tokens.usage: Wasurenagusa 勿忘草 — person colour 1 (Max in the sheets). Avatar square, 8 px square, 40 × 3 px tile top rule. Always with the person's name; never for state.

tokens.name: person-momo
tokens.usage: Momo 桃 — person colour 2 (Lena). Same uses as the other person colours.

tokens.name: person-moegi
tokens.usage: Moegi 萌黄 — person colour 3 (Jonas). Closest hue to Yamabuki (75° vs 41°) and still distinct.

tokens.name: person-fuji
tokens.usage: Fuji 藤 — person colour 4 (Sam).

tokens.name: on-person
tokens.usage: Initial inside a person avatar square (7.6–9.7 : 1 on all four). People colours sit at 1.7–2.2 : 1 on Kinari, so the name next to them carries the meaning.

families.jp: "IBM Plex Sans JP", "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page title, once per page, under its section label. Plex Sans Light 40/40, −2 %.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Section label: two-digit number, em dash, uppercase name. Plex Mono 500 11/16, +14 %. The numbering is optional and only on pages with three or more sections; under 1440 px wide the number may be dropped.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body, dialog text, nav items, table cells. Lines ≤ 72 characters.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Meta: uppercase, +6 %, parts joined by ' · '. Plex Mono 11/16 (was 10): functional Mono text is at least 11 px, Sans text at least 12 px.

styles.name: meta-12
styles.usage: Larger meta: row numbers, system column, durations in tables, toggle state words. Was meta-11.

styles.name: dialog-title
styles.usage: Dialog title, a question or a statement; under a section-label line naming the area.

styles.name: header-title
styles.usage: Title in the 56 px run header bar (running game, Multiview).

styles.name: item-title
styles.usage: Item titles in lists and the selected table row; empty-state headings.

styles.name: item-title-sm
styles.usage: Cover tile titles, Multiview tile names, runner names, the server name in the nav footer. One line, ellipsis.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: 36 px buttons. Primary and danger 500; secondary and ghost 400.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: 32 px buttons, header buttons, toast actions (500).

styles.name: input
styles.usage: Text in fields and the chat composer.

styles.name: field-label
styles.usage: Label above a field; chip and segment text uses 12/16 400.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Games on this PC still run.
styles.usage: Helper and error lines, empty-state explanations, notes.

styles.name: table-header
styles.usage: Table column heads, uppercase, `dim`, on a `rule` underline.

styles.name: system-code
styles.usage: System chips: GB, GBC, GBA, NDS, 3DS — always these exact codes.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Small accent tags (AUDIO) and nav count badges.

styles.name: address
styles.usage: Code and address values: hosts, ports, paths, versions. Never uppercase.

styles.name: invite-code
styles.usage: A large invite or pairing code, shown alone in a dialog. Uppercase, groups of four joined by a hyphen.

styles.name: vertical-label
styles.usage: The vertical label of the open column (writing-mode: vertical-rl), `dim`. Decoration only: shown at 1440 px wide or more, never carries information.

styles.name: wordmark-nav
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the 20 px mark in the sidebar lockup (gap 10).

styles.name: wordmark-display
styles.usage: Display lockup beside the 52 px mark (gap 16): About, splash, installer welcome.

styles.name: jp-accent
styles.usage: Optional ウズメ after the display lockup, `muted`. Only on About, splash and installer welcome — nowhere else.

spacing.note: 8 px baseline; 4 and 12 are the only half steps.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control: avatar overlap, label-to-hint, stacked game screens.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base step: between buttons, icon and label, field label and field.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Row padding, toast and icon gaps, nav item padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button padding (36 px), sidebar padding, header gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between cover tiles and Multiview tiles; side panel padding; register-mark inset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between page sections; Multiview padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Below the sidebar lockup; bottom page margin.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page margins (top, left, right) and the gap between the content and the open column.

tokens.name: row-28
tokens.usage: Compact density (800 px windows): nav items and online rows; chips and segments.

tokens.name: row-32
tokens.usage: Nav items, small buttons, header buttons.

tokens.name: row-36
tokens.usage: Fields and standard buttons.

tokens.name: row-44
tokens.usage: Table rows, toasts.

tokens.name: row-48
tokens.usage: Runner rows, run tabs.

tokens.name: header-56
tokens.usage: Run header bar of the running game and Multiview.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: AppNav width.

tokens.name: open-column
tokens.usage: The open right column of every list page, with its vertical Mono label.

tokens.name: side-panel
tokens.usage: The running game's side panel.

tokens.name: dialog
tokens.usage: Standard dialog width: confirmations and short forms.

tokens.name: dialog-lg
tokens.usage: Wide dialog: forms with several fields, lists to choose from, invite and pairing flows.

tokens.name: register-mark
tokens.usage: Arm length of a register mark (1 px, `rule` on pages, `dim` around the game stage).

tokens.name: person-marker
tokens.usage: Width of the 3 px person-colour rule on a tile's top-left edge.

tokens.name: mark-nav
tokens.usage: Mark size in the sidebar lockup.

tokens.name: menu
tokens.usage: Minimum width of menus and select lists (on `surface`, framed by `rule`).

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest hit target for mouse and keyboard (icon buttons, the × of a field, table row actions).

tokens.name: target-tv
tokens.usage: Smallest focus target at the TV text scale: rows, buttons and icon buttons grow to 44, list rows to 48.

tokens.name: columns-compact-max
tokens.usage: Below this window width a page shows at most three columns including AppNav; the open column, help column and vertical label collapse.

radius.note: Ma has no rounded corners. The only exception is the app icon tile.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every UI element: buttons, fields, chips, tiles, toasts, dialogs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-app-icon
tokens.usage: The app icon tile only (220 → 49.5 px). Pixel-fitted 32/16 tiles use stepped corners instead.

shadow.note: No elevation shadows anywhere. These are 1–2 px markers drawn as inset rings.

tokens.name: elevation
tokens.usage: Toasts, dialogs and menus: no shadow; `surface` plus a 1 px `rule` frame separates them.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus, always visible. Sumi: 2 px gap + 2 px Yamabuki (9.5:1). Kinari: 2 px Yamabuki + 1 px Sumi outside, so the ring reaches 3:1 against paper.

tokens.name: focus-ring-inset
tokens.usage: Keyboard and gamepad focus inside a container that clips an outer ring: menu and list items, nav items, online rows. Same Yamabuki 2 px, drawn inward; on Kinari with 1 px Sumi inside so it reaches 3:1.

tokens.name: marker-start
tokens.usage: Selection marker at the start of a selected row or menu item, in `ink`. Together with `selected` and weight 500.

tokens.name: marker-nav
tokens.usage: Active item in AppNav and in a ColumnNav: Yamabuki on Sumi, `accent-text` on Kinari (Yamabuki alone is 1.7:1 on paper).

tokens.name: marker-under
tokens.usage: Active tab underline: Yamabuki on Sumi, `accent-text` on Kinari.

tokens.name: audio-ring
tokens.usage: The Multiview tile whose audio you hear: with a Yamabuki border, 2 px in total, plus the AUDIO tag.

tokens.name: text-scale-standard
tokens.usage: Default text size (Settings › This PC › Appearance › Text size: Standard).

tokens.name: text-scale-large
tokens.usage: Large: every type style × 1.25, rows and controls unchanged unless the text needs it.

tokens.name: text-scale-tv
tokens.usage: TV: type × 1.25 (body 17.5 px), every focus target at least `target-tv`, rows 44 / 48, the HintRow always visible.
